sentiment: We are the curators now of machines we did not build, keeping old light alive in new glass.

stories.title: My server is a phone now
stories.summary: A developer replaced their server infrastructure with a smartphone, routing traffic through a cellular connection and Tailscale — a quiet observation about how the device in your pocket has become the data center in your pocket.

stories.title: Microsoft Word for Windows 1.1a, Native X64 Port
stories.summary: A native x64 port of Microsoft Word 1.1a for Windows, preserving decades-old software by recompiling it for modern hardware — quiet digital archaeology.

stories.title: Os8088: A powerful Mac-like OS for the IBM XT, 286, 386
stories.summary: An operating system for old IBM PCs that brings a Mac-like experience to ancient hardware, driven by nostalgia and the challenge of making old machines feel purposeful again.
